Package model

Klasse ChessBoard

java.lang.Object
model.ChessBoard
public class ChessBoard extends Object
ChessBoard stores the state of a chess board and provides methods for retrieving and updating it.

    • applyMove

      public void applyMove(Move move, ChessPiece capturedPiece)
      Captures the given piece and applies the given move to the chess board. The given move is stored in the movement history. After the move has been applied, updates the active player's color to the opponent's color. Note: The movement's destination and the captured piece's position may differ, which is why this method takes the captured piece as an additional parameter. Note: This method is not fit for applying castling moves. See applyCastlingMove(Move, Move) for that.
      Parameter:
      move - The move to apply
      capturedPiece - The piece to capture, or null if no piece has to be captured
      Siehe auch:
      • Move
      • ChessPiece
      Requires:
      move != null

    • applyCastlingMove

      public void applyCastlingMove(Move kingMove, Move rookMove)
      Applies a castling move to the chess board using the given king and rook moves. After the move has been applied, updates the active player's color to the opponent's color. Both the king's and the rook's moves are added to the movement history in said order.
      Parameter:
      kingMove - The king's move
      rookMove - The rook's move
      Siehe auch:
      • Move
      Requires:
      kingMove != null, rookMove != null

    • undoLastMove

      public void undoLastMove(ChessPiece capturedPiece)
      Reverts the last recorded move from the internal movement history and adds the given previously captured piece back in. After the move has been reverted, updates the active player's color to the opponent's color. Note: This method is not fit for reverting castling moves. See undoLastCastlingMove() for that.
      Parameter:
      capturedPiece - The previously captured piece, or null if no piece was captured in the last move
      Siehe auch:
      • ChessPiece

    • undoLastCastlingMove

      public void undoLastCastlingMove()
      Reverts the last two recorded moves from the internal movement history. After the moves have been reverted, updates the active player's color to the opponent's color.
